rule.C1: geometric mean over the 17 models of the seed-median min-bulk-ESS/gradient ratio owalnuts-da-rhosum / owalnuts-da >= 1.10 (a model with a missing median on either side is excluded from the geomean and reported)
rule.C2: no model has that ratio below 0.85
rule.C3: the pooled funnel tail-mass z for rhosum is within +-2 of 0.0478 under both the paper tuning and the sampler defaults (the endpoints control is reported alongside; freeze_mode_v1 measured it at z -1.70 on one seed at the defaults)
rule.C4: Eight Schools strict-track geomean min-bulk-ESS/call ratio rhosum / endpoints >= 0.9
rule.not_gated: the cross arm (reported only); gate counts (reported; expected within +-2 cells of the endpoint arm because the rule changes orbit length, not the leaf test); wall (shared machine, upper bounds)
rule.statement: Flip sampler::Tuning::default() to UTurnRule::MomentumSum if and only if all four hold; otherwise leave the default and report why.
